items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 33:1
items.html: At the time of the ascent of Arich Anpin to the first three of Atik, when the aspect of the correction of the MEM-LAMED-TZADIK in the Mochin of Arich Anpin is nullified, and the Avir becomes one level with the Galgalta, then Mocha deAvira is discerned as the Daat of Atik. For the aspect of the Galgalta of Arich Anpin is not distinguished from the aspect of RADLA even in the permanent forehead of Arich Anpin, on account of the correction of the MEM within it, as is known. Hence now, at the time of the ascent to Atik, the Avir is discerned as the Daat of Atik. As written above in Answer 28, see there. (Page 441, Item 9; Page 327, Item 73).
